description: Mounted on a pole as a memorial to Robin E Miller, the Sugar Bird Lady, who flew the real VH-REM around Western Australia from September 1968 to July 1972 delivering polio vaccine in sugar lumps to remote Aboriginal communities and died in December 1975. Reported to be an engineering experimental prototype M20H donated by Mooney Aircraft; the memorial was unveiled on 20 May 1978 and the marks are not the airframe's own.
aliases: M20; M20H; Sugar Bird Lady; c/n 1
